sections.heading: 1. In, out and moving
lines: ① Sit first, knees together, swing both legs in.
② Each stop: 10 sec stand tall, lean back.
③ Slide boot loads to the edge before lifting.
④ Set the seat once: knees slightly bent.

slides.title: Back still bugging you?

Causes differ for everyone.
An assessment comes first!
slides.heading: Get these checked promptly

caption:
Forty stops a day and Lulu's back feels every one of them.

For couriers, tradies and reps, it's often the getting in and out that bothers the back more than the driving. Try sitting first with your feet outside, then swinging both legs in together. Reverse it to get out.

At each stop, take ten seconds to stand tall, lean back gently and walk a few steps. Slide boot loads to the edge before you lift.

Numbness in the legs or saddle area, or bladder or bowel changes, need prompt medical attention.

Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can look at your back and your workday. Book online via the link in bio.
